_comment: FROZEN sampling patches on refs/pickup_truck.png. Each rect was placed by sliding a w x h window inside the zone's colour-family component (components of the nearest-reference classifier) and keeping the most uniform placement whose median sits within 20/255 of the family reference; `median` is the record of what was measured, scripts/measure-vehicle.mjs and scripts/likeness.mjs recompute it from the pixels every run (the pixels stay the authority) and measure-vehicle prints median + purity per zone. Every zone samples >= 25 px. Rects are [x, y, w, h], origin top-left, in the 1024x1024 target. `role` is the vehicle-class role whose id-pass mask the zone is compared against; `face` marks the two flat body tones likeness reads (front = the +X flank the renderer presents, side = the +Z nose face).
_subjectBoxes_comment: Union of rects that contains the truck and its wheels; the white ground abstains by areaTolerance. Used by likeness.mjs for the whole-picture share (informational).

body_side.note: the +X flank: door panel below the side window, and the bed side; purity 1.000

body_front.note: the +Z nose face, either side of the grille between the lamps; same tone as the flank (flat cel paint, side/front 1.0)

bed_inside.note: the bed floor / inner walls, the one darker body tone

glass.note: windshield centre and the near side window

mirror.note: far and near mirror heads (paler and bluer than the glazing)

tyre.note: outer tyre face ring, front and rear visible wheels

tread.note: the visible tread band left of each tyre face
tread.roleRuling: Opus 5 2026-09-13: classes/vehicle.md makes a tread ring role tyre; likeness colours a zone from its role pixels, so role wheel could never see tread pixels

bumper.note: front bumper top at the far end, rear bumper block

grille.note: the two recessed grille slots (3 px tall bands between the slats)
